#[inline]
pub fn double(n: i32) -> i32 {
    n * 2
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    /// A doc comment between the attribute and the function it marks.
    fn doubles() {
        assert_eq!(double(2), 4);
    }

    #[rstest]
    #[case(1, 2)]
    fn doubles_each_case(n: i32, want: i32) {
        assert_eq!(double(n), want);
    }

    fn helper() -> i32 {
        1
    }
}
